narrator.description: calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you dig a tunnel from the yard to the kitchen, you get midnight snacks. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the dirt roof keeps caving in. So you add wooden frames, like an old gold mine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the shovel is so loud, it wakes up the dog. So you dig with a spoon... for three weeks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But you pop up in the doghouse. So this time you measure: twelve steps from the back door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the kitchen floor is solid tile. So you cut one tile and turn it into a secret trapdoor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the snacks are on the top shelf. So you build a tiny pulley that lowers them straight into the tunnel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, you built a secret snack tunnel.
